verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents standard OAuth 2.0 authentication with a 'scopes catalog gating access per module,' plus explicit steps for registering a client and generating access/refresh tokens — this supports issuing module-scoped credentials that an agent (or MCP integration) could use. However, there's no documentation of finer-grained (e.g., read-only vs write, per-record, or agent-specific/time-limited) credential scoping beyond module-level OAuth scopes, and no explicit guidance framing this for AI-agent least-privilege use cases. Missing for 10: granular read/write or resource-level scopes, explicit agent-oriented least-privilege guidance, and independent confirmation of scope enforcement in practice.
